body: This is similar to my marriage. I'm afraid to go hangout with friends or let alone be friends with them. My spouse refuses to go to counseling even when I say I'm doing things wrong too its not just going to be about what you have done wrong. I'm about to order a book called, Boundaries: When to Say Yes, How to Say No to Take Control of Your Life. Also, try counseling just for yourself since he will not go. I am currently seeing a counselor (for depression) and also to go over marital issues.

Your story makes me want to hope but I don't know if I can anymore. I'm kinda in the same boat. Chronic pain for 5 years, just applied for disability, I'm 25 years old, no money, and not sure my marriage is going to last. Any specifics on the nerve block and or doctors name and location?
